description: This Dart source file defines the WalletProvider class, which manages and exposes state related to a wallet application. It handles transaction and category data, persistence of user preferences, and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: WalletProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages wallet-related state, including transactions, categories, and preferences, and provides methods for manipulating this state.

methods.name: WalletProvider
methods.description: Constructor that optionally accepts repositories, defaulting to new instances.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the repository data, loads user preferences, and refreshes state.

methods.name: _loadPrefs
methods.description: Loads the last used transaction type filter from persistent storage.

methods.name: _saveTypePref
methods.description: Persists the transaction type filter to storage.

methods.name: setTypeFilter
methods.description: Sets the transaction type filter and refreshes data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recomputes balances, categories, and transaction list, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new transaction and updates state.

methods.name: updateTransaction
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction and updates state.

methods.name: deleteTransaction
methods.description: Deletes a transaction by ID and updates state.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Adds a new category and updates categories list.

methods.name: updateCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category and refreshes categories list.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Attempts to delete a category; returns an error message if in use.
